author: robin.sculac on Sketchfab
basis_label: Wilson basketball sizing guide: size-7 circumference
note: Photogrammetry of a worn Spalding basketball by robin.sculac, captured with 3DF Zephyr. The photographed seams, pebbling, printed markings and wear replace the original dimensioned illustration. The source does not identify its ball size or supply a measured diameter: this specimen is uniformly calibrated to the catalog’s representative 239 mm diameter, rather than claimed to be a measured size-7 ball. Source proportions, colors and scan irregularities are retained; no surface was filled, reshaped or generated.

operations: Stage source glTF with embedded images resized to at most 1024 px; remove unused animations
Convert legacy specular/glossiness material to standard metallic/roughness using glTF Transform 4.5.0
Deduplicate, flatten, join, weld and prune; no simplification or new geometry
Quantize positions to 16 bits, normals to 12 bits and UVs to 14 bits; no mesh or texture codecs
Preserve photographed color, wear, seam layout, proportions and source topology
